name: emotion_synonym
description: Map an emotion adjective in a person's statement to happy, sad, angry, or afraid; control copies the person's name.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
groups={'happy':['delighted','joyful','ecstatic','cheerful','elated','thrilled'],'sad':['miserable','sorrowful','dejected','heartbroken','gloomy','downhearted'],'angry':['furious','irate','enraged','incensed','livid','outraged'],'afraid':['terrified','fearful','scared','frightened','petrified','alarmed']}
names=['Alice','Bob','Carol','David','Emma','Frank','Grace','Henry']
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 label=list(groups)[i%4]; adjective=random.choice(groups[label]); name=random.choice(names)
 s=f'{name} says: "I feel {adjective}."'
 items.append({'prompt':s+'\nWhich basic emotion is expressed: happy, sad, angry, or afraid?\nAnswer:', 'answer':' '+label})
 control.append({'prompt':s+'\nWhat is the name of the speaker?\nAnswer:', 'answer':' '+name})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
